{{Quote|Have General Loathsom delay the Jedi as long as possible. I will need time to execute the next part of my Master's plan.''"<br />"''Yes, mistress.|Asajj Ventress and the tactical droid|audio=ChristophsisTacticalDroid2-THE.flac|<ref name="THE" />}}
This '''T-series tactical droid''' was the third [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|such droid]] to be involved in the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]].

==History==
After her [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|duel]] with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] ordered this [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] to relay orders to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]]: prepare to march on the [[City/Legends|city]] and take over [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]].<ref name="THE" /> Ventress then departed in the [[Trident (starship)/Legends|''Trident'']] to execute the next part of her [[Dooku/Legends|Master's]] plan, which involved capturing [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]] and turning his father, [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. However, Loathsom was unable to prevent the Republic and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from capturing Christophsis, and Ventress and [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku failed in their exploit as well.<ref name="TCW">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This tactical droid was voiced by [[James Arnold Taylor]], who also provided the voices of Obi-Wan Kenobi and [[TJ-55/Legends|the other tactical droid]] during the episode.
